map.买房是家庭最大宗支出之一。ToolBox 房贷计算器在本地帮你测算月供、总利息与: Buying a home is one of the largest outlays a family makes. The ToolBox mortgage calculator works out your monthly payment, total interest and total repayment locally, comparing the equal-installment and equal-principal repayment methods.
map.支持等额本息与等额本金两种算法: Supports both equal-installment and equal-principal algorithms
map.输入贷款总额、年利率、年限即得月供: Enter total loan, annual rate and term to get the monthly payment
map.输出总利息、还款总额: Output total interest and total repayment
map.可对比两种方式的总成本差异: Compare the total cost difference between the two methods

map.比较等额本息与等额本金哪个更省利息: Compare which of equal-installment and equal-principal saves more interest
map.评估提前还款的潜在收益: Evaluate the potential benefit of early repayment
map.不同首付比例下的月供试算: Try monthly payments under different down payment ratios
map.填写年利率（如 3.95%）与贷款年限（如 30 年）: Fill in the annual rate (e.g. 3.95%) and loan term (e.g. 30 years)
map.点击计算，查看月供、总利息、总额: Click calculate to view monthly payment, total interest and total amount
map.切换另一种方式对比总成本: Switch to the other method and compare total cost
map.等额本金前期月供高但总利息更少，适合前期还款能力强的人: Equal-principal repayment means higher early payments but less total interest, suiting those who can pay more early on
map.利率用\"年利率\"，别误填月利率: Use the "annual interest rate", do not enter a monthly rate by mistake
